name: Wild-Lake
description: Wild-Lake is an existential mechanics studio and A&R venture for world-class creators. We develop artists and build the infrastructure around their work, identity, and long-term vision.

itemOffered.name: Existential mechanics
itemOffered.description: We examine the patterns, pressures, and structures shaping how you create and make decisions. Together, we map what supports the work and what needs to change.

itemOffered.name: Artists & repertoire
itemOffered.description: We scout talent and develop the creative work, its identity, and its direction. The artist’s long-term vision guides the practice.

itemOffered.name: Infrastructure for independence
itemOffered.description: We build the systems, workflows, and working structures around the artist so the practice can endure without giving away ownership.

itemOffered.name: Mentorship for artists
itemOffered.description: Bring your creative work and the life around it. Explore long term creative and personal support through embodied practice, sustained attention, and room for becoming.

itemOffered.name: Confidence coaching
itemOffered.description: Practice building self trust through body based awareness and clear boundaries. Begin with what you notice, what you need, and the choices available to you.

itemOffered.name: Self love coaching
itemOffered.description: Explore practical repair and congruence between your choices and your values. Practice learning to inhabit your body, not operate it.
